## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the reason for it.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Quality, privacy, and safety claims are supported by an evaluator or
      another checkable source.
- [ ] Failed and inconclusive results remain in the accounting.
- [ ] Public artifacts contain no prompts, raw answers, credentials, private
      paths, customer data, or proprietary fixtures.
- [ ] Documentation states the tested scope and known limits.

## Validation

List the exact local checks run and their results.
